notes: One row per distinct ABN printed on Commonwealth CCS enforcement rows (enforcement-actions-all.csv abn column), resolved with ABN Lookup AbnDetails. lookup_status ok, not_found, excluded_individual or error. Rows for individuals or sole traders keep no name of any kind (CLAUDE.md rule 2); business names that read as a person's name are withheld unless already an ACECQA organisation name. ABR data is as reported by the ABR and is not verified here; verify any ABN on ABN Lookup before it is shown publicly.

abr_source.licence: ABN Lookup Web Services Agreement v9.9.7, https://abr.business.gov.au/Tools/WebServicesAgreement (see research/2026-10-30-register-abn-lookup.md)
abr_source.cache: data/raw/abr-lookup/ is a local, gitignored cache; each row records the query endpoint, looked_up_at and the sha256 of the cached response instead
abr_source.credential: the GUID is never stored; every recorded URL has the guid parameter removed
